baseline.name: P14_FLAT_HARNESS_REVIEW
baseline.scope: Topology only. No CAD read/import or placement modification.

catalog.boundary: Stall torque is not a continuous operating torque. Stall current not published in this source.
Published voltage/torque variants conflict; only4.8V reference used. Purchased unit identity unverified.
Reference manual, exact purchased revision and current-limit behavior unconfirmed.
50Hz simulation uses4.8828125us quantization. No actual register/I2C hardware used.

assumptions.battery: OCV piecewise linear[(SOC0,6V),(.1,6.8),(.5,7.6),(1,8.4)]. R=.06ohm. Capacity2.2Ah user pack label. OCV/R unmeasured.
assumptions.claw_spring_load_Nm: .012+.045*clamp(q/50deg,0,1); generic equivalent, not saved claw spring geometry
assumptions.regulator: Per-device model fields in device-catalog.json; efficiency/dropout/current limit behavior generally unmeasured. Published continuous rating is not a trip threshold.
assumptions.MCU: Stop threshold on5V input4.5V, recovery+0.15V; not measured ESP brownout behavior
assumptions.PCA: 25MHz typical / prescale121 =>4.88us tick; underpowered PCA clears external PWM; unknown oscillator variation and full-register behavior.
assumptions.fuse: Optional excess(I²-Irated²) integral with20s relaxation;120A²s threshold. NOT actual fuse trip curve.
assumptions.motor_bus_current: Conservative magnitude/torque proportional approximation; no PWM duty-resolved electrical winding model
assumptions.angles: Test-relative axes, not R69 joint zeros or actual kinematic mapping. All axes bounded±80deg by virtual stops.
assumptions.limits: No geometry, contact, walking stability, temperature, regeneration, switching ripple, EMI, real firmware timing, hardware I/O.
